tasks.label: Stop old LUMAR runtime
args: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'dotnet|node' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LUMAR_ERP_API_V2|LocalWhatsApp|local-whatsapp' }; foreach($x in $p){ Stop-Process -Id $x.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "KILL:$($x.ProcessId):$($x.Name):$($x.CommandLine)" }

tasks.label: Monitor current gateway session
args: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$tokenPath = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LUMAR\\LocalWhatsAppGateway\\gateway-token'; $token = (Get-Content $tokenPath -Raw).Trim(); for ($i = 1; $i -le 4; $i++) { try { $s = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5094/session/status' -Headers @{ Authorization = \"Bearer $token\" } -Method Get; $backend = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 5093 } | Select-Object -First 1; $gateway = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq 5094 } | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output \"POLL:$i STATE:$($s.state) LINKED:$($s.linked) CURRENT:$($s.currentNumber) LASTERROR:$($s.lastError) BACKENDPID:$($backend.OwningProcess) GATEWAYPID:$($gateway.OwningProcess)\" } catch { Write-Output \"POLL:$i ERROR:AUTH_OR_STATUS_FAILED\" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8 }"

tasks.label: Clean LUMAR project-owned locks and run LocalWhatsAppFoundationTests

args: Write-Host 'BACKEND_PORT_5093'; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5093 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host 'GATEWAY_PORT_5094'; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5094 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host 'GATEWAY_COUNT'; (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LocalWhatsApp[\\/](src[\\/])?server\.mjs' } | Measure-Object).Count; Write-Host 'GATEWAY_PIDS'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'LocalWhatsApp[\\/](src[\\/])?server\.mjs' } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize
